name: Venture Scorer
description: Scores ventures on completeness, market fit, and execution readiness. Updates venture metadata.

config.script: return {venture_id: data.venture_id, venture_name: data.venture_name, sector: data.sector};

steps.name: Query roles filled for this venture

config.script: const roles_filled = roles_assigned.length; const roles_total = 7; const caps_filled = capability_metrics.capabilities_assigned; const caps_total = capability_metrics.total_capabilities_needed; const acq_started = acquisition_tasks.length > 0 ? 1 : 0; const score = (roles_filled / roles_total) * 50 + (caps_filled / caps_total) * 30 + (acq_started) * 20; return {completeness_score: Math.round(score), roles_filled, capabilities_assigned: caps_filled, acquisition_started: acq_started};

body.prompt: Assess {{venture_info.venture_name}} ({{venture_info.sector}}) market fit (0-100). Consider: problem clarity, target customer size, competitive landscape, founding team expertise. Return JSON: {market_fit_score: int, market_size_estimate: string, competition_level: string, recommendation: string}

Rate {{venture_info.venture_name}} execution readiness (0-100). Current state: {{completeness_metrics.roles_filled}}/7 roles, {{completeness_metrics.capabilities_assigned}}/10 capabilities, acquisition_started={{completeness_metrics.acquisition_started}}. Return JSON: {readiness_score: int, blockers: string[], next_priority: string}

config.subject: Venture Scored: {{venture_info.venture_name}} - Overall {{(completeness_metrics.completeness_score + market_assessment.market_fit_score + readiness_assessment.readiness_score) / 3 | round}}%
